comments: This person could be identified as the 14th-century Mi nyag Bla ma ye shes rdo rje (http://purl.bdrc.io/resource/P9718). The third abbot of gSer ri dgon in Mi nyag, born in 1343 also has this name, and is reported to have taught at "Ra this dga' ldan gling" (which could be (ID:5960)) (see [UNV7NRZ8]). He would have been 60 at the time Blo gros grags pa (ID:4130) composed his Abhidharma commentary (ID:5281).
